gate.phase_note: core_ready_offset_cycles describes next falling-edge presentation; actual post-rising ready is2ns earlier

profile.queues: Unlimited per-stream FIFO, fixed stream modulo cores binding, per-core round robin. One active job per core, no preemption. Full independent nine-round windows arrive every 9000ns per stream. Waiting inputs expire at arrival+9000ns; instantaneous input handoff at exactly the deadline is allowed. Already active kernels may finish later.

resource_projection.resource_evidence: Same resource-fit projection as the prior V80 capacity profile. Reference hierarchy footprints predate the SI1000 finite-memory variant. This is not demonstrated ten-slot placement or a measured footprint of the adapted RTL.

profile.scope: CORE-COMPUTE upper bound: idealized wide/buffered I/O; native byte protocol and wrapper not implemented/measured. Not actual interface or hardware throughput.
profile.service: Actual frozen per-shot Helios kernel counter multiplied by 4ns. Transport, initialization and readout negligible/overlapped; same assumption for Static and QShell. Ideal capacity uses the same actual predictions at zero service time.
profile.source_scope: Frozen d9, nine-round SI1000 finite-memory Helios corpus; no counter, noise, correction or RTL changes. Complete independent windows are stateless; 256 streams, ten cores and unlimited storage are projections, not deployed hardware.

scope: CORE-COMPUTE upper bound: idealized wide/buffered I/O; native byte protocol and wrapper not implemented/measured. Not actual interface or hardware throughput.
source_audit: Cache rebind verifies input/prediction/codec/gate hashes, all native shard receipts and counters, and saved codec-validated trace hash. No native/wrapper transport timing is claimed.
